theory.heading: What Docker for Django is
theory.body: Docker for Django describes the methods and patterns used within Python Full Stack to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Docker for Django is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Docker for Django matters
theory.body: Without Docker for Django, systems built with Python Full Stack are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Docker for Django works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Docker for Django follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Docker for Django.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Docker for Django
theory.body: Docker for Django offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
